notes.note: Fix-round source delta review: inspected the retained learning image and current 26-case Chromium captures at 390/412/1440 widths in both themes. ReleaseNotes now omits Installation sections while retaining later change sections; the capture fixture includes an installation command and asserts it is absent. Existing learning images show only change notes and still accurately represent this renderer; no geometry or image replacement is needed. The server popup deduplication and named persistent notice changes do not alter these manually opened panel/history images. Controlled fixture evidence only; native/provider/publication qualification remains separate.
